items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Stecklet Interview, 1959-06-15
items.q: So this old brother, I can't think of his name anymore. But every year he used to win the first prize on tomatoes. So I was doing some work down near his place. And I said to him, his name is Mark.

ctx.x: Yes, all the picnics and everything out there. So they have music there too?

Oh, yeah, they used to have a regular lay there. Because the gardeners used to give a picnic there. And when the young girls, their daughter would be, you know, sitting down there, and the fellow would come along, he'd top them on the show and tell them, dance with my daughter and I'll give you a quarter. Yeah. To get them to dance with some of them girls. Then they had at the gardeners picnic, they had a fellow every year. He used to win the best prize on tomatoes. You see? Of course, it was open to all the…

might come to me later. I said to him, you must have some device that you, or something that you pump in those tomatoes to make them develop so big. I said, can't you tell the fella the name? He says, that's what all of them gardeners is trying to find out. He says, I know I got that laid up every year that I'm going to win the first prize on tomatoes.
